# Synthetic PDF fixture

`synthetic.pdf` is generated entirely from invented text, coordinates and pixel
values in [generate.go](generate.go), using the standard-library-only PDF writer
in `internal/pdftest`. It contains no names, addresses, document identifiers,
external fonts, copied images, timestamps or machine-specific metadata.

The fixture is intended to be committed and redistributed with GoPD's tests.
No third-party document or asset is used. Repository-wide licensing is managed
separately; this file does not assign a license to the project.

Run from the repository root:

```text
go run ./testdata/generate.go
go run ./testdata/generate.go -check
go run ./examples/gopd -json testdata/synthetic.pdf
go test ./...
```

The generator writes stable bytes with fixed object order, offsets and LF line
endings. It reads no input document. `-check` compares the committed file with
the generated bytes without modifying it. Root and CLI tests require the file;
a missing fixture fails the tests.

| Page | Text operations | Graphics | Image placements |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | 2 | 2 | 1 |
| 2 | 2 | 1 | 1 |
| Total | 4 | 3 | 2 |

The two pages share one Courier font and one ASCIIHex-encoded 2x2 RGB image.
Page two invokes a Form XObject containing text and a triangle. The expected
text, in content order, is:

1. `GoPD synthetic fixture`
2. `Alpha beta 123`
3. `Page two: shared resources`
4. `Reusable form`

There are no annotations or expected interpretation diagnostics. Tests cover
page grouping, exact text order, shared resources, Form provenance, source
ranges and CLI output. Unicode and malformed-input cases use separate synthetic
fixtures in the unit tests.
